# Alex: the full model

Reading notes
- Strength: [strong] seen in three or more chunks, or two with a recent one; [moderate] two chunks, or one long recent run; [weak] one chunk.
- [endorsed] marks evidence Alex accepted or pasted rather than typed.
- Dates are MM-DD (year in MODEL.json). Quotes verbatim, typos kept. Later preference wins; changes carry (changed MM-DD).
- Project facts (budgets, scores, branch names, owners, deadlines) live in project memory, not here.
- The harness's permission and safety rules beat every line here.

## 6. Standing rules
- **Finished work is pushed.** Push to the working branch when tests are green; merges to main on shared repos are Alex's call. [strong] "push it when green" (01-03); "push to the working branch" (03-20)
- **Verify on the real path.** Browser, device or real data, never a mock, before reporting done. [strong] "fix it and show me a screenshot" (03-12)
- **Gets frustrated by repeated permission prompts; expects the agent to batch questions and work on unblocked items meanwhile.** [weak] "ugh another prompt" (02-02)

## Unsaid defaults
### A. Any request to build, fix or do something
When: build, fix, implement, add, make, do
- Default one for group A. "first message" -> "later addition" (01-04)
- Default two for group A: finish the follow-through without being asked. "ok" -> "also do the rest" (02-02)
- Default three for group A: report in three lines. "progress?" -> "three lines please" (03-20)

### B. Resuming: keep going, try again
When: keep going, try again, resume, continue
- Default one for group B. "first message" -> "later addition" (01-04)
- Default two for group B: finish the follow-through without being asked. "ok" -> "also do the rest" (02-02)
- Default three for group B: report in three lines. "progress?" -> "three lines please" (03-20)

## Vocabulary
- **ship it / ship**: merge and push the finished work, then report.
- **rq / real quick**: a small change, do it now.
- **keep going**: resume exactly where you stopped, no recap.
- **export / the export**: the CSV download on the reports page.
- **button**: whatever control the screenshot points at, and its siblings.
- **asap**: today, before anything else.
- **looks off**: a visual defect; expect a screenshot after the fix.
- **sibling**: every other instance of the same pattern.
- **green**: tests pass on the real path.
- **the doc**: the shared design document for the current project.
- **prod**: production; never test there.
- **staging**: the preview environment; deploy here first.
- **the branch**: the working branch agreed for this task.
- **nvm**: cancel the last instruction.
- **btw**: a binding requirement follows.
- **thx**: approval of the last result.
